cap: The ovarian vessels come from the aorta and run in the infundibulopelvic ligament; the left ovarian vein drains to the left renal vein and the right to the IVC. The uterine artery, from the anterior division of the internal iliac, runs over the cardinal ligament and crosses over the ureter about 2 cm lateral to the cervix. In men the ductus deferens is the bridge, and the seminal vesicle joins it at the ejaculatory duct.
